description: Source code for a digital watch face service on Android Wear, including rendering, configuration, and Google API integration.

classes.name: DigitalWatchFaceService
classes.description: Main service class for the digital watch face, extending CanvasWatchFaceService.

classes.name: DigitalWatchFaceService.Engine
classes.description: Inner class handling rendering, configuration, and data updates for the watch face.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the watch face style, paints, calendar, and formats.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Removes update messages and cleans up.

methods.name: onCreateEngine
methods.description: Creates and returns an instance of the Engine.

methods.name: onVisibilityChanged
methods.description: Handles registration and unregistration of receivers and Google API client based on visibility.

methods.name: onApplyWindowInsets
methods.description: Adjusts layout and text sizes based on device shape (round or square).

methods.name: onPropertiesChanged
methods.description: Adjusts paint styles based on device properties like burn-in protection and low-bit ambient.

methods.name: onTimeTick
methods.description: Triggers redraw on each clock tick.

methods.name: onAmbientModeChanged
methods.description: Adjusts rendering for ambient mode, including color and anti-aliasing.

methods.name: onInterruptionFilterChanged
methods.description: Handles mute mode changes, adjusting update rate and transparency.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Renders the current time, date, and day of week on the canvas.

methods.name: updateTimer
methods.description: Starts or stops the update handler based on current mode.

methods.name: shouldTimerBeRunning
methods.description: Determines if the update timer should be active.

methods.name: updateConfigDataItemAndUiOnStartup
methods.description: Fetches initial configuration data and updates UI accordingly.

methods.name: setDefaultValuesForMissingConfigKeys
methods.description: Ensures default config values are set if missing.

methods.name: addIntKeyIfMissing
methods.description: Adds a key with default value if absent in config.

methods.name: onDataChanged
methods.description: Handles updates to configuration data from the Data Layer.

methods.name: updateUiForConfigDataMap
methods.description: Applies configuration changes to UI elements.

methods.name: updateUiForKey
methods.description: Updates specific UI elements based on config key.

methods.name: onConnected
methods.description: Handles successful connection to GoogleApiClient.

methods.name: onConnectionSuspended
methods.description: Handles suspension of GoogleApiClient connection.

methods.name: onConnectionFailed
methods.description: Handles failure to connect to GoogleApiClient.
